soc2.title: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (AICPA, 2017 with 2022 points of focus)

controls.title: Logical access to protected assets
controls.runtime: Every tool call is admitted to a run bound to its principal and agent, authorized against pinned packs and grants, and refused once revoked.

controls.title: Authorization and least privilege
controls.runtime: Grants narrow at every delegation; task authorization bounds what the principal asked for; a capability that requires user roles refuses a delegated run whose user lacks them; amendments and revocations are recorded.

controls.title: Boundaries against external threats
controls.runtime: Effects outside the isolation boundary or the gateway's environment are refused; data flows are labelled and classified egress refused.

controls.title: Unauthorized or malicious software
controls.runtime: Only pinned packs and reviewed, digest-pinned capabilities run; pack loads and rollouts are recorded.

controls.title: Monitoring for anomalies
controls.runtime: Trusted monitoring scores actions; circuit breakers trip on bursts; repeated effects and shared-limit breaches are refused.

controls.title: Evaluation of security events
controls.runtime: Escalations hand blocked or unusual calls to a human with the audited decision.

controls.title: Incident response
controls.runtime: Revocations stop an agent, pack or tenant on the next call; unknown outcomes are reconciled and applied effects compensated.

controls.title: Change management
controls.runtime: Pack versions are immutable and released through gates; rollouts, conformance assessments and task amendments are recorded.

controls.title: Processing integrity: complete and accurate processing
controls.runtime: Each effect is claimed once, its outcome observed or reconciled, and shared limits settled from the outcome.

controls.title: Control environment, communication, risk assessment and monitoring of controls
controls.runtime: Outside the runtime.
controls.note: Organizational: policies, training, risk assessment and oversight are the deployer's.

controls.title: Record-keeping
controls.runtime: A signed, hash-chained record of each admission, decision, approval, effect and refusal, verified offline in this pack.

controls.title: Monitor operation and interpret output
controls.runtime: Decisions carry reason codes and evidence references; escalations carry the audited decision to a human.

controls.title: Awareness of automation bias
controls.runtime: Approval decision times are recorded; approvals faster than the review floor, without step-up, or never decided are recorded as such.

controls.title: Override or reverse
controls.runtime: Approvals and denials bind the exact action; applied effects are compensated and unknown outcomes reconciled.

controls.title: Stop the system
controls.runtime: Revocations apply on the next call; circuit breakers trip them automatically.

controls.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
controls.runtime: Untrusted content is contained by flow labels, results are screened and schema-checked, and actions are monitored.

controls.title: Deployer obligations
controls.runtime: Logs kept, oversight assigned, operation monitored.
controls.note: Deployment: log retention, assigned overseers and instructions for use are the deployer's; this pack is one of their logs.

controls.title: AI system life cycle
controls.runtime: Packs are released through gates, rolled out in stages and pinned; conformance is assessed.

controls.title: Data for AI systems
controls.runtime: Data flows are labelled and classified egress refused; run data is erased on request; memory changes are governed.

controls.title: Use of AI systems
controls.runtime: Each use is tied to its principal, purpose and task authorization; a capability can require the delegating user to hold given roles; consequential actions need approval.

controls.title: Third-party relationships
controls.runtime: Upstream tools are pinned by digest and drift is refused before dispatch.
controls.note: Configuration: upstream pins are checked at startup and on each call; attach the configuration report.

controls.title: Policies, organization, resources, impact assessment, information for interested parties
controls.runtime: Outside the runtime.

controls.title: Agent goal hijack
controls.runtime: Untrusted content cannot grant authority; effects after untrusted input need approval.

controls.title: Tool misuse and exploitation
controls.runtime: Default-deny dispatch of pinned capabilities; loop and repeated-effect guards; action monitor.

controls.title: Identity and privilege abuse
controls.runtime: Runs bound to principal, agent and delegated user, with the full delegation chain recorded; grants verified and unrevoked; a capability can require the delegating user to hold given roles.

controls.title: Agentic supply chain
controls.runtime: Digest-pinned capabilities and packs; upstream drift refused.

controls.title: Unexpected code execution
controls.runtime: Effects outside an active isolation boundary are refused.

controls.title: Memory and context poisoning
controls.runtime: Memory changes are governed lifecycle records.

controls.title: Insecure inter-agent communication
controls.runtime: Delegation narrows authority; children's outputs need acceptance.

controls.title: Cascading failures
controls.runtime: Conserved budgets and shared limits; unknown outcomes hold; breakers stop bursts.

controls.title: Human-agent trust exploitation
controls.runtime: Approvals bind the exact action, with step-up, a review floor and timeouts.

controls.title: Rogue agents
controls.runtime: Kill switch, breakers and trusted monitoring.
